title: Ask chat has the mock's New Conversation button, its whole transcript, and an icon for each command
goal: The Ask chat matches the last parts of the mock it still leaves out: a button that starts a new conversation, the earlier requests shown above the latest one, and each row of the / command list wearing its own icon rather than one for its area.
notes: Left by typing-in-ask-lists-the-commands-you-can-run. Mock: askPalHTML in docs/design/mocks/shared/dist/photonz-ds.js. AskConversationLines and AskCommandsList.symbol in Sources/Photonz/Agent/AskViews.swift; AppCommandTable has no icon today. New Conversation has to decide what Ask forgets: its memory of what it made comes from the rows (AskSession.conversation).
acceptance: The chat header has the mock's New Conversation button, and pressing it starts a conversation that does not lean on the one before
The chat shows the requests of this conversation in order, as the mock's chat does, not only the latest
Each row of the / list shows an icon for that command, as agent-generate-wt.html does, not one shared by its whole area
